top_100_rule_assisted_semantic_triage.methodology: Counts are overlapping cue matches within the predicted span and 100 surrounding characters. They assist manual review and are not corrected ground truth.

findings: Many label-counted false positives removed by v3 are first-party courses, memberships, merchandise, affiliate calls to action, or other promotional material outside the external sponsor label.
Some removed predictions are plausible unlabeled commercial segments, confirming that the held-out labels remain imperfect.
The additional v3 false negatives include clear external sponsor reads, so the recall cost of the 0.65 threshold is real rather than only a labeling artifact.
The calibrated v3 model is appropriate as a high-precision operating point; a lower threshold should remain configurable when recall is preferred.
